title: Joe Gabriel's orchestra and brass band
summary: Gabriel led an orchestra and a ten-piece brass band, and Jiles describes the instrumentation.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played what: early band size and instrumentation

blocks.x: Did Joe Gabriel have a brass band, Gabriel?
Yeah, he had orchestra and a brass band. Now that's a guy you should interview too. He's in Thibodeau.
He's so sick, I don't know if we can do it or not.
We went out to see him one time. Oh, I see.

He has fainting spells now, you know. And whenever you go to see him, he gets excited and faints. So I don't know whether we'll be able to do it or not. We ought to go try it anyway. Anyhow, what kind of brass band was that? Did it have a name or anything?
And he just used his own name for it. Do you know how big it was? Do you remember it at all?
Yeah. His band carried about seven pieces. The brass band? No, the brass band carried ten pieces. Ten pieces. That's right.
What sort of a line-up would it have? What kind of instruments would it have?

What kind of instruments would it have? Oh, trombone, val trombone, clarinet, saxophone, bass drum, alto horn, and Joe Gabriel would play the bass drum because he was a violin player in his orchestra.
So it had sort of the same line-up they're using today?
Yeah, simul, that's the only thing they used the vowel trombone, one of the trombone players.
